_comment: REFERENCE ONLY — not loaded by any code path (engine.py builds AsyncEngineArgs directly; grep the repo, nothing imports this file). Kept as a human-readable summary of the live GPU-profile settings and MUST be updated by hand whenever engine.py::_build_gpu_args changes, or it will drift out of sync again the way it previously did (this copy used to say max_num_seqs=64 / gpu_memory_utilization=0.80 while the real code shipped 256 / dynamic-utilization — pure documentation debt, not a live bug, but confusing to anyone who read this file instead of the code).
description: Optimized SOTA vLLM Multi-LoRA Profile for NVIDIA DGX (Grace-Blackwell / Ada / Ampere)
gpu_memory_utilization: dynamic — TARGET_TOTAL_MEMORY_GB (default 32) / real detected VRAM, or 0.90 on cards smaller than the target; see engine.py::_build_gpu_args
kv_cache_dtype: fp8 on Hopper/Ada/Blackwell (real capability probe, not a hardcoded flag), auto (bf16) elsewhere
